brief:
Families across Gaza are searching for children and relatives who have gone missing during the prolonged conflict, according to Al Jazeera English. The disappearances span years of warfare, leaving parents and other family members without answers about the whereabouts or fates of their loved ones.

The scale of missing persons underscores the humanitarian cost of the war on Gaza's civilian population. Families have undertaken their own search efforts to locate missing relatives amid ongoing instability, damaged infrastructure, and limited access to official records or information about detainees and those who have disappeared. The searches continue despite significant obstacles facing residents attempting to account for missing family members.
dek: Families in Gaza continue searching for children and relatives missing in the war.
title: Gaza families search for children missing after years of war
